methods.name: execute
methods.behaviour: case on alu_op over OP-008..OP-014; any other code reports $error

datapath.compute: alu_result = a >> amt (logical: a is unsigned, so zeros fill)
alu_result = (a << amt) | (a >> (32 - amt)); amt = 0 gives a >> 32 = 0, so the result is a

locals.name: a
locals.why: makes >> a logical shift (D-004) and rotates see plain bits

spec_text.FR-006: Define logical_alu as a class derived from base_alu and support the listed logical operations.
spec_text.OP-013: result = A rotated left by B[4:0] within 32 bits
spec_text.OP-014: result = A rotated right by B[4:0] within 32 bits
spec_text.D-003: Shifts and rotates act on operand_A; the amount is operand_B[4:0] (0 to 31). Amount 0 returns A unchanged.
spec_text.D-004: Resolved by the language: the spec declares int, which is 32-bit, signed, 2-state in SystemVerilog. Arithmetic wraps modulo 2^32. Shift right is logical (>>), rotates work on 32 bits.
spec_text.D-002: in1/operand_A is the first operand, in2/operand_B the second. Binary ops compute A op B; SUB is A - B. Port-B ops (SEL_B, INC_B, DEC_B) use operand_B only.
